rounds.text: Frontier Springs Ltd is drastically under-appreciated by a market fixated on a temporary 13% one-year share price drop [E25] and a lagging relative strength rating of 19 [E50], ignoring an exceptional fundamental reality. The company boasts world-class capital efficiency, printing a staggering ROCE of 42.43% to 50.9% and an ROE scaling up to 39.9% [E10, E12, E13], completely outstripping sector benchmarks of 10.39% and 16.83% [E9, E10]. This elite profitability is backed by explosive growth engines, demonstrated by a 104% three-year and 79% trailing-twelve-month compounded profit expansion alongside a 39% surge in recent sales [E16, E17, E20, E21]. Operational execution is firing on all cylinders, evidenced by operating margins expanding by 15 percentage points over three years to reach 27% by March 2026 and an order book exceeding 300 crores providing clear revenue visibility [E30, E81]. Furthermore, management has guided for gross revenues to cross 500 crores in FY27 supported by strong sector tailwinds and robust Indian Railways production plans for coaches and locomotives [E73, E77, E78]. Conceded: the price-to-book ratio is elevated at 8.55x [E2], and cash conversion sits at a modest 0.51x of reported profit [E34]. Despite these headline valuation friction points, the underlying earnings power and intrinsic value estimates point to a significant disconnect between current market pessimism and operational reality [E44].
